title: AI Agent生态成熟驱动云计算架构重构：边缘部署、缓存优化与后量子安全成新焦点
core_insight: AI Agent技术从概念验证进入企业级规模化部署阶段，同时驱动云计算基础设施向边缘AI、智能缓存架构演进，并加速后量子安全等下一代技术路线图的实施

dimension_texts.technology: Cloudflare推出Durable Object Facets和AI代理沙箱技术，实现动态Worker与持久化数据库深度集成；AWS推出S3 Files将对象存储转换为高性能文件系统；Google Cloud QueryData工具将自然语言转换为数据库查询 微软在Kubernetes操作成熟度取得新进展；Cloudflare公布2029年后量子安全路线图；Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless实现秒级数据库创建 Durable Objects in Dynamic Workers: Give each AI-generated app its own database Agents have their own computers with Sandboxes GA What's new with Microsoft in open-source and Kubernetes at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026 Cloudflare targets 2029 for full post-quantum security Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems QueryData helps agents turn natural language into queries for AlloyDB, Cloud SQL and Spanner Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds Why we're rethinking cache for the AI era
